Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and presence of E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL, indicating a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and low specific gravity are also noted. No ketones or significant proteinuria detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
